correctness.rationale: A degree-two subdivision vertex forces distinct original colors; with five colors every partition normalizes uniquely. The other ten vertices each have three choices. Exactly 15 permissible color-class edge graphs on four allowed roots are classified by odd positive degree, giving a bijection to disjoint covers of the ten clique edges. The explicit 1024-mask recurrence gives 201, or 6 after restricting to matching color classes. Independently the explicit 15-vertex adjacency checker exhausts all 3^10=59049 assignments and reproduces the counts, four local profiles, and six S5 orbits (sizes 6,15,30,30,60,60); their total is 201 and Burnside agrees. All critical finite state spaces and code are attached.

originality.rationale: The closest direct predecessor, Caro et al., arXiv:2509.20763 Proposition 17(i), establishes the exact five-color minimum for S(K_5), and that known value is not claimed. Its inspected subsection gives constructions and minimum values, not counts or orbit decompositions of all optimal color partitions. A square-coloring/total-coloring result would account for the six square partitions but not 195 extra strong odd partitions. Searches of the foundational papers, relevant graph-invariant records, and graph/number aliases found no covering tabulation; residual unindexed priority risk is expressly retained.
residual_risks: Unindexed private graph-invariant tabulations or unpublished computations could already contain the 201-partition census.
Some later or inaccessible literature may contain an equivalent graph-orbit enumeration; public priority is not independently certified.
The strongest directly relevant prior source already establishes χ_so(S(K5))=5; the novelty claim expressly excludes that fact.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification at the first nontrivial odd clique subdivision where the n-color lower bound is attained but optimal strong odd colors need not satisfy square-color rigidity. The count 201 versus 6 shows that parity creates 195 additional optimal partitions; the 15 admissible edge-factor types and six automorphism-orbit classification supply reusable structural and enumeration benchmarks. The graph and invariant are motivated by existing 2024-2025 primary work, not an arbitrary parameter slice. An infinite-family enumeration is neither claimed nor necessary for the finite classification.
